title: Diffusion Models for Tabular and Time Series Bootcamp
summary: Vector Institute bootcamp material on diffusion models for tabular and time-series data, with worked single-table and multi-table synthesis pipelines. SDV is the measuring instrument throughout: `gen_multi_report.py` imports `evaluate_quality` from both `sdv.evaluation.single_table` and `sdv.evaluation.multi_table`, the pipelines build `MultiTableMetadata` and `SingleTableMetadata`, and density and detection scores come from SDMetrics' `QualityReport` and `LogisticDetection`, with `sdv==1.11.0` pinned. SDV's metadata and evaluation layers are run to score models it did not produce.

title: AIForge
summary: A hand-organised atlas of the AI, machine-learning and data-science ecosystem, over two thousand documents with an index README per directory. One of them, `SDV_(Synthetic_Data_Vault).md`, is a page on SDV that explains the Python SDK and shows a worked `download_demo` plus `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` example. SDV's copula synthesizer is reproduced as a usage example inside a reference atlas rather than run by the repository.

title: CALM-Data-Generator
summary: A PyPI-published Python library for generating synthetic tabular and sequential data with its own generators. Its quality reporting is SDMetrics: `_quality_scoring_mixin.py` drives `sdmetrics.reports.single_table.QualityReport` and, for sequences, `sdmetrics.reports.sequential.QualityReport`, with `sdmetrics>=0.27.0,<0.28.0` pinned and a migration test asserting the import. SDMetrics is called as the scoring engine behind a competing generator's reports.

title: ASID
summary: An AutoML tool from ITMO University for small and imbalanced tabular datasets, which selects a generative model to enlarge the sample before fitting a classifier. The model zoo it searches over is SDV's: `generative_model_estimation.py` imports `GaussianCopula`, `CTGAN`, `CopulaGAN` and `TVAE` from `sdv.tabular` and scores each candidate with `sdv.evaluation.evaluate`, with `sdv==0.17.1` pinned. SDV supplies both the candidates and the selection criterion.

title: SuperconGAN
summary: A PyPI package for training a GAN on superconductivity data, described in its own README as based on the CTGAN library. All three of its modules are SDV: `model.py` fits a `CTGANSynthesizer`, `validate.py` scores it with `sdmetrics.single_table.MLEfficacy`, and `evaluate.py` calls `sdv.evaluation.evaluate`, with `ctgan`, `sdv` and `rdt` declared in `setup.py`. SDV supplies the model, the metric and the evaluation loop; the contribution is the materials-science dataset.

title: GAN data augmentation on NIDS algorithms
summary: A master's dissertation experimenting with vanilla, Wasserstein and self-attention GANs to augment the improved CIC-IDS-2017 dataset for MLP and random-forest intrusion detectors. SDV is not one of the generators but the referee for all of them: every notebook builds a `SingleTableMetadata` and scores its output with `evaluate_quality`, `run_diagnostic` and `get_column_plot` from `sdv.evaluation.single_table`. SDV's evaluation module is run as the common yardstick across the hand-written GANs.

title: DGGAN
summary: A demographic GAN that generates synthetic customer records to improve a fraud-detection model. Its evaluation notebook is SDV's: `sdmetrics.reports.single_table.QualityReport` produces the score and `get_column_plot` and `get_column_pair_plot` the figures, over an `sdv.Metadata` description of the table, with `sdv>=0.17.1` and `sdmetrics>=0.7.0` pinned. SDMetrics is run to judge a generator built outside SDV.

title: NLP Master 2025 course
summary: Syllabus and notebooks for a master's-level natural language processing course running from text preprocessing to large language models. Its data-generation unit teaches SDV directly: `synthetic_data_generation.ipynb` loads a demo table with `sdv.datasets.demo.download_demo`, describes it with `SingleTableMetadata` and fits a `CTGANSynthesizer`. SDV's demo loader and conditional GAN are run as the teaching example for synthetic data.

title: TabSCM
summary: A framework for mixed-type tabular generation that combines structural causal models with decision trees and diffusion, with its file layout adapted from the official TabSyn implementation. CTGAN comes along with that layout: a copy sits in `baselines/ctgan/` and is driven by `main.py` and `sample.py` as one of the compared generators, while the reported density and detection numbers come from SDMetrics' `QualityReport`, `DiagnosticReport` and `LogisticDetection`. CTGAN is vendored as a baseline and SDMetrics is run as the yardstick.

title: Conditional diffusion models for vehicle speed trajectories
summary: The reproducibility package for a paper on conditional diffusion models for vehicle speed trajectory generation, submitted to Transportation Research Part C. SDV's `PARSynthesizer` is one of the approaches it evaluated and rejected: the consolidated evaluation report diagnoses mode collapse under PAR, attributes it to exposure bias, and proposes context noise and higher sampling temperature before pivoting to diffusion for its ability to pin the boundary conditions. SDV's sequential model is run as a compared approach whose failure motivates the paper's method.

title: Deep Generative Modeling for Networks (RAND)
summary: Code for the RAND Corporation's FY2020 Initiated Research project on deep generative modeling for networks, worked through notebooks over the NDSSL synthetic-population data. The graph-generation notebook fits `CTGANSynthesizer` twice to generate the node and edge attribute tables that the graph model is then conditioned on. CTGAN is called as the attribute generator inside a policy-research population model.

title: Onto-CGAN
summary: Onto-CGAN, a generative framework that draws on disease ontologies so a conditional GAN can produce patient records for diseases absent from the training data. It is assembled out of SDV's supporting machinery rather than calling it: `constraints/base.py` imports `sdv.constraints.errors` alongside `copulas`' `GaussianMultivariate` and `GaussianUnivariate`, `metadata/dataset.py` builds on `sdv.constraints.Constraint` and RDT's `HyperTransformer`, `data_transformer.py` uses RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder`, and the model class documents itself as wrapping `CTGANSynthesizer`. SDV's constraint, metadata and transform layers are reimplemented into a new synthesizer.

title: Retail data warehouse project
summary: A three-phase exercise in building an e-commerce data warehouse: dimensional model, ETL pipeline, then analytical queries. The dataset it loads is manufactured by SDV: `generator/mix_generator.py` fits five separate `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` instances — products, users, sellers, orders and payments — each over its own `SingleTableMetadata`, and stitches the results into a related retail dataset. SDV's copula synthesizer is run to produce every table the warehouse is built on.

title: DRL_DGM
summary: Code for the ICLR 2025 paper 'Beyond the Convexity Assumption: Realistic Tabular Data Generation under Quantifier-Free Real Linear Constraints', which proposes a disjunctive refinement layer bolted onto existing deep generative models. CTGAN is one of the models it is bolted onto: a copy sits in `synthetizers/CTGAN` with its processors in `data_processors/ctgan`, built on RDT's `NullTransformer` and `TransformerInputError`, and the TableGAN path reads SDGym's column-type constants. CTGAN's source is vendored as one of several base generators the constraint layer wraps.

title: FRAUDX
summary: A graduation project building a full-stack credit-card fraud detection system that combines deep learning, synthetic data and a language model for plain-language explanations. The synthetic half is SDV end to end: the GAN notebooks fit `CTGANSynthesizer` over `SingleTableMetadata` on the credit-card and Euro fraud datasets and check each result with `evaluate_quality`, `QualityReport` and `DiagnosticReport` from `sdv.evaluation.single_table`, with `sdv>=1.4` pinned. SDV's synthesizer and evaluation module are run as the rebalancing stage of the pipeline.

title: FLIPAD
summary: Code for 'Single-Model Attribution of Generative Models Through Final-Layer Inversion' (ICML 2024), which identifies which generator produced a given sample. For the tabular part of the study the generators being attributed are SDV's: `scripts/training/train_sdv_models.py` trains `CTGAN`, `TVAE` and `CopulaGAN` from `sdv.tabular`, with `sdv==0.18.0`, `ctgan==0.7.5`, `rdt==1.7.0`, `sdmetrics==0.9.3` and `copulas==0.8.0` pinned. SDV's tabular models are run as the population of models the attribution method must tell apart.

title: Synthflow
summary: A Python package for the end-to-end production of differentially private synthetic data, accompanying arXiv 2405.00267. SDV supplies part of its generator shelf and all of its preprocessing: `generation/models/__init__.py` reaches for `sdv.tabular.GaussianCopula` and `ctgan.synthesizers.CTGANSynthesizer`, and `generation/processing.py` runs RDT's `HyperTransformer` and transformer set, with `sdv<0.13` and `rdt<0.6.0` pinned. SDV's copula and GAN models are called as non-private baselines beside the DP mechanisms.

title: synthetic_aml pipeline
summary: A configurable pipeline for clinical tabular data that runs preprocessing, hyperparameter optimisation of both the generative models and the CatBoost evaluation models, training, sampling and evaluation from YAML config files, with an acute myeloid leukaemia dataset as the worked example. CTGAN is not installed but carried: the entire `sdv-dev/CTGAN` repository sits under `src_others/CTGAN/`, tests and `HISTORY.md` included, with `rdt==1.3.0` pinned alongside. CTGAN's source is vendored as one of the generative models the pipeline tunes.

title: HML — human-in-the-loop machine learning
summary: A human-in-the-loop machine learning platform from the ZJU VIPA lab, deployed as a set of Docker services with Celery task workers. It carries a modified CTGAN in `HML/utils/ctgan_new/`, whose `CTGANSynthesizer` subclasses the vendored `BaseSynthesizer` over RDT's `OneHotEncodingTransformer`, and drives it from a PowerNet dataset task through `ctgan_data_generation_c` and a `ctgan_data_train_tablenet_loss` variant. title: BuildML
summary: A Python machine-learning workflow library built around a stateful `Session` that records every preprocessing and training operation. Its synthetic-data subpackage is an SDV adapter: `synthetic/adapters/sdv.py` constructs `CTGANSynthesizer`, `TVAESynthesizer` and `CopulaGANSynthesizer` over `SingleTableMetadata`, `adapters/sdmetrics_eval.py` scores the result with `QualityReport`, and `synthetic/extras.py` gates both behind optional-import checks, with `sdv>=1.17` and `sdmetrics>=0.15` declared. SDV is called as the only generation and scoring backend the module offers.

title: MIDST challenge
summary: The Vector Institute's MIDST challenge at SaTML 2025, in which entrants mount membership inference attacks against diffusion-based synthetic tabular data. Its ClavaDDPM reference implementation is scored with SDV: `gen_multi_report.py` calls `evaluate_quality` from both `sdv.evaluation.single_table` and `sdv.evaluation.multi_table` over `MultiTableMetadata` and `SingleTableMetadata`, and the eval scripts add SDMetrics' `QualityReport`, `DiagnosticReport` and `LogisticDetection`. SDV's evaluation stack is run as the fidelity baseline a privacy attack is judged against.

title: PRELIM
summary: A Python package for improving decision-tree-like interpretable models trained on small samples, by fitting a stronger mediator model and generating a transfer set for the simple classifier to learn from. Two of its transfer-set generators are SDV's: `generators/gaussiancopula.py` and `generators/copulagan.py` wrap `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and `CopulaGANSynthesizer` behind a common interface with a graceful fallback when the import fails, and `sdv>=1.36.0`, `ctgan>=0.12.0` and `copulas>=0.12.0` are declared. SDV's copula models are called as two generators among the package's several.

title: Machine and deep learning study roadmap
summary: A personal study roadmap collecting courses, projects and notes across machine learning and deep learning. Its graduation-project notes include a page on tabular GANs that records where CTGAN lives in practice — `sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer` and `ctgan.CTGAN`. title: CMUDarknet
summary: A university research project detecting darknet traffic on the CICDarknet2020 dataset, comparing machine-learning classifiers trained with and without generated data. SDV runs both halves of that comparison: `basic_temp.ipynb` imports `TVAE`, `CopulaGAN`, `CTGAN` and `GaussianCopula` from `sdv.tabular` and nine metrics from `sdv.metrics.tabular`, and there is a dedicated generation notebook per model — `CTGAN_traffic_generation.ipynb` and `CopulaGAN_traffic_generation.ipynb` — each scored with `sdv.evaluation.evaluate`. SDV's models and metrics are run as the study's generation and evaluation stack.

title: ARTSyn
summary: ARTSyn, formerly DeepCoreML, a library of models and algorithms for tabular data synthesis aimed at classification and regression under class imbalance. SDV is a first-class member of its resampler zoo: `Resamplers.py` imports and instantiates `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer`, `CTGANSynthesizer`, `TVAESynthesizer` and `CopulaGANSynthesizer` beside the library's own cGAN, sbGAN and ctdGAN, `TabularTransformer.py` is built on RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder`, and `eval.py` uses `SingleTableMetadata`. SDV's synthesizers and RDT's transformers are called as core components of a competing library.
